estimation_procedure.description: Estimate a separate accounting function for each firm-year using the 16 previous quarterly observations. Table 1 describes 71,295 such fits, not 71,295 observations within one fit. To construct pairwise comparability, evaluate both firm i and firm j functions at the SAME firm-i quarterly return: fitted_Earnings_ii = alpha_i + beta_i*Return_i and fitted_Earnings_ij = alpha_j + beta_j*Return_i. CompAcct_ij is the negative average absolute difference between those predictions over the 16-quarter window. Rank peer values from highest to lowest: CompAcct4 is the mean for the four highest-comparability peers, and CompAcctInd is the median across peers in the same two-digit SIC industry. The peer universe has fiscal year ends in March, June, September or December. Reported pairing exclusions remove holding/Group/ADR/LP-name variants and highly similar firm names using five-or-more letter words while avoiding generic words; the complete implementation/stop-word list is not reported. These subsequent predictions/aggregations are deterministic uses of the same fitted function, not additional estimated regression equations. No December-only analyst sample restriction is imported into the broader fit sample.
